CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE stg_order_lines AS
SELECT
      order_line_id,
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      store_id,
      product_id,
      quantity,
      unit_price_centavos,
      line_amount_centavos,
      CAST(line_amount_centavos AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) / 100 AS amount_mxn,
      line_type,
      channel,
      status,
      category,
      order_ts,
      order_date
FROM (
  SELECT
      order_line_id,
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      store_id,
      product_id,
      quantity,
      unit_price_centavos,
      line_amount_centavos,
      line_type,
      channel,
      status,
      category,
      order_ts,
      order_date,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_line_id
        ORDER BY extract_ts DESC, source_file DESC
      ) AS rn
  FROM raw_order_lines
